s0_pip_wake_1.speaker: PIP
s0_pip_wake_1.text: Wake up. Please. Wake up! The captain wants all hands!

s1_vance_order_1.speaker: VANCE
s1_vance_order_1.text: You. Take the wheel! Bow into the swells, never side-on!

s1_vance_good.speaker: VANCE
s1_vance_good.text: Good. Keep her steady. Hold this heading.

s2_tobin_intro.speaker: TOBIN
s2_tobin_intro.text: Come here! Hands on the iron. Aim high on the roll and clear the channel!

s2_tobin_done.speaker: TOBIN
s2_tobin_done.text: Not bad at all! Thirty years I've fired these, and you've got the touch.

s3_ismene_shout.speaker: ISMENE
s3_ismene_shout.text: Port side breach! We're taking on water! Grab planks and bail!

s4_pip_light.speaker: PIP
s4_pip_light.text: There! A light through the storm! A lighthouse ahead!

s4_vance_conclusion.speaker: VANCE
s4_vance_conclusion.text: Whatever that light is, the hull won't survive till dawn out here. Steady as she goes.

s5_pip_silence.speaker: PIP
s5_pip_silence.text: It stopped... the rain, the wind. Why is the sea so quiet?

s5_tobin_compass.speaker: TOBIN
s5_tobin_compass.text: Here, Pip. Take my compass. For luck.

s7b_tobin_line.speaker: TOBIN
s7b_tobin_line.text: The sheet line! If I cut it, she rights herself! Keep her steady!

s7d_ismene_forgive.speaker: ISMENE
s7d_ismene_forgive.text: It follows the light! I told them it was a map... it was a leash. Forgive me!

s7e_vance_fire.speaker: VANCE
s7e_vance_fire.text: I have the wheel! For Tobin! For Roque! Give them everything!

s8_vance_lash.speaker: VANCE
s8_vance_lash.text: Lash yourselves! All of you! Pip, to the mast!

s9_kael_intro.speaker: KAEL
s9_kael_intro.text: Easy. Easy. You're alive. I found you on the rocks... just you. Who told you to sail toward the light?

s9_kael_q2.speaker: KAEL
s9_kael_q2.text: What did you see in the water before the wave broke?

s9_kael_q3.speaker: KAEL
s9_kael_q3.text: Did your ship carry anything it shouldn't have?

s9_kael_finish.speaker: KAEL
s9_kael_finish.text: Then it hasn't finished... the lantern has called something else.
